title: Conditional Neural SDEs for Financial Time-Series Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41405v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conditional generation of time-series paths is a central problem in probabilistic modeling, where the goal is to simulate future trajectories that are both realistic and responsive to external context. It has direct applications in finance and economics. Neural stochastic differential equations provide a natural framework for this task by combining continuous-time stochastic dynamics with learnable drift and diffusion functions. However, directly modeling the target state can be unstable in conditional settings, especially when the target and conditioning variables have strong level dependence, limited training data, or different dimensions.We propose a residualanchor Neural SDE architecture that decomposes the target into a learned conditional anchor and a stochastic residual. The anchor captures the context-dependent baseline, while the Neural SDE (Stochastic Differential Equation) models the residual dynamics around this baseline. T

translated_title: 面向金融时间序列生成的条件神经随机微分方程
translated_abstract: 时间序列路径的条件生成是概率建模中的一个核心问题，其目标是模拟既真实又能响应外部上下文的未来轨迹，在金融和经济学领域有着直接的应用。神经随机微分方程通过将连续时间随机动力学与可学习的漂移和扩散函数相结合，为这一任务提供了天然的框架。然而，在条件设定下直接对目标状态建模可能是不稳定的，尤其是当目标变量与条件变量之间存在强烈的水平依赖、训练数据有限或两者维度不同时。我们提出了一种残差锚定神经SDE架构，将目标分解为一个学习得到的条件锚点和一个随机残差：锚点捕捉依赖于上下文的基线，而神经SDE（随机微分方程）则对该基线附近的残差动态进行建模。
tldr: 提出一种残差锚定的条件神经随机微分方程架构，通过将目标分解为条件锚点与随机残差，稳定地生成能够响应外部上下文的金融时间序列轨迹。
en_tdlr: Proposes a residual-anchor conditional Neural SDE architecture that decomposes the target into a learned conditional anchor and a stochastic residual, enabling stable generation of context-responsive financial time-series trajectories.
